newsitem.title: GREECE: EXPLOSIONS DAMAGE FOUR YACHTS IN ATHENS MARINAS.
newsitem.headline: EXPLOSIONS DAMAGE FOUR YACHTS IN ATHENS MARINAS.

text.p: Explosions damaged four yachts in two Athens marinas on Thursday but there were no injuries, police said.
"We believe the blasts were caused by small explosive devices and we assume the motive was criminal but we are investigating all possibilities," a police spokesman said.
The yachts were docked in the Alimos and Mikrolimano marinas near the main port of Piraeus. The owners were unknown but the flags were Greek.
